receipts.code:
import adsk.core, adsk.fusion

def run(context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    root = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct).rootComponent
    path = root.sketches.item(0).sketchCurves.item(0)
    planeInput = root.constructionPlanes.createInput()
    planeInput.setByDistanceOnPath(path, adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(0.5))
    root.constructionPlanes.add(planeInput)
